scope: Refresh public open-source DWG/DXF peer capability statements and active issue reports; reconcile them with existing local implementation and consumer gates without promoting support.

sources.observed: README says the reader covers DWG versions with some advanced R2010+ objects skipped; the writer cannot create R2007 and R2010-R2018 output has CRC failures.
README version matrix advertises DWG read/write by AC version, with AC1021 writing excluded and AC1024/1027/1032 writing marked available.

Reports cover resource/recursion failure modes, classic POLYLINE/VERTEX parsing, strict DXF wire rejection, CP949 label/byte disagreement, and ACIS writer omission. #1240 remains open, without reviews/deployment on the inspected page, and depends on schema work.
sources.evidenceClass: issue and pull-request reports; not local defects or released capability evidence

sources.observed: Current DWG policy documentation describes read-only, default-off import; its ledger contains read-direction claims only and reports no promoted claims at the documented pinned library state.

researchFindings: Peer capability must be keyed by exact version, operation, entity/carrier family, and consumer; version matrices are not aligned tests.
Peer issue reports sharpen existing resource, classic-entity, strict-writer, and codepage test families but do not establish matching libdxfrw defects.
An open/unreviewed/unreleased PR is not a released peer writer capability.
LibreCAD_3's current stated DWG direction is read-only; compatibility and 3D consumer expansion remain separate gates.

existingOwnersReinforced: XDATA/EED size accounting and traversal budgets
classic POLYLINE/VERTEX framing and malformed-record isolation
strict DXF wire census and codepage label-plus-byte validation
ACIS owner/block membership and release-vs-PR distinction
